units: Sabb. 33ᵇ חַיֵּי עולם everlasting life (future world), ח׳ שעה temporary life (physical wants).—חיי נפש necessaries of life. Y. Ned. IX, 42ᶜ the support of the poor of one’s own place.
Pes. 113ᵇ חַיֵּיהֶם אינם חיים whose life is no life (deserving the name); a. v. fr.—חַיֶּיךָ, בְּחַ׳ by thy life!, as thou livest! Lev. R. s. 15; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 3a">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>חַיֶּיךָ וחַיֵּי ראשך</he> by thy life, and by thy head!—<he>יורד עמו</he> (<cite ref="P00114"><he>עד</he></cite>) <he>לחַיָּיו</he> persecutes him even as far as to deprive him of his livelihood.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:8">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>, beg.; a. fr.—

Lev. R. s. 19 בית חַיֵּינוּ our house of life (the Temple). Mekh. Yithro, Amal., s. 2 (ref. to Ex. XVIII, 20) הודע להם בית חַיֵּיהֶם make known to them their house of life (prayer, study; v. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.); B. Mets. 30ᵇ; B. Kam. 99ᵇ, sq. (v. comment.).—[חַיִּים the living ones, v. חַי.]
